steps.name: Install Vale
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
url="https://github.com/vale-cli/vale/releases/download/v${VALE_VERSION}/vale_${VALE_VERSION}_Linux_64-bit.tar.gz"
sha="4bf5c5176b682b1da0830f471584d3494f1c2e27ee3029e1ad6f6661d4962182"
mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/vale"
curl -fsSL -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/vale.tgz" "$url"
echo "$sha  $RUNNER_TEMP/vale.tgz" | sha256sum -c -
tar -xz -C "$RUNNER_TEMP/vale" -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/vale.tgz" vale
echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/vale" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

steps.name: Enforce Vale on the clean set (error level blocks)
Check the fixtures (strict config)
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
for bad in .vale/fixtures/bad-*.md; do
  good="${bad/bad-/good-}"
  if vale --config .vale/strict.ini "$bad" >/dev/null; then
    echo "::error::$bad passed but must fail"; exit 1
  fi
  vale --config .vale/strict.ini "$good" >/dev/null \
    || { echo "::error::$good must pass"; exit 1; }
done
